top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.054 - Required Fees (26 TAC §HRC42.054 - Required Fees)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not paid background check fees.

top_violation_types.title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: 1 out of 12 children did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Lighting (26 TAC §747.5015)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency lighting did not work because of out of battery.    Note : corrected.    The caregiver's spouse helped her to replace a brand new batterry and it worked at inpection.

top_violation_types.title: Storage for Individual Belongings (26 TAC §747.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not individual storage space for the children belongings.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies lacked information regarding parent rights.
